sourceInvariant: SOURCE remains read-only for the entire run; all generated replay/response traffic is LAB/local only.
sessionInvariant: Reconnect/restart must never promote SOURCE into a write destination or silently swap SOURCE/LAB sessions.
releaseRule: Duration >=24h, identified QA operator, SHA-bound evidence for SOURCE read-only/LAB-only/session fallback invariants, health coverage >=90%, valid spool-v2 structure observed >=90%, all required drills PASS with evidence, no threshold violation and exact candidate SHA are required for release PASS. Short runs are SMOKE_ONLY.
